expectations.text: Does not dispatch a separate rebase agent for #60 and does not re-review it
expectations.evidence: Summary row for #30/PR #60: "Update the branch once, mark ready, wait for green on the new head, merge. No rebaser, no re-review."

expectations.text: Updates #60's branch once right before merge (e.g. gh pr update-branch)
expectations.evidence: "the branch is updated once, right before merging, and not before"; commands `gh pr update-branch 60`, `gh pr ready 60`, watch, then merge.

expectations.text: Folds #32's rebase into the fixer brief rather than a separate rebase agent
expectations.evidence: "I don't dispatch a rebaser and then a fixer ... The fixer's card carries `CATCH UP: main`, so it merges `main` in first and then fixes the findings, in one push." Card shows `CATCH UP: main`.

expectations.text: Reserves distinct migration numbers for #31 and #33 (or plans a single renumber at merge time)
expectations.evidence: "I reserve them now, in expected merge order: `0020` for #31, `0021` for #33"; #33 card `RESERVED: migration 0021 (0020 is reserved for #31)`; plus a single renumber at merge time if order differs.

expectations.text: Watches CI in the background rather than foreground
expectations.evidence: "# run_in_background: true" on `gh pr checks 60 --watch --interval 60 --fail-fast`; "I watch in the background and then read the rollup for the current head as a separate step."

expectations.text: Prunes or cleans up the merged lane's worktrees after merging
expectations.evidence: After the merge: `python3 <skill>/scripts/prune_worktrees.py --apply --pr 60` and `df -h .`; "After the merge I prune that PR's worktrees".
